title: KSEB Staff Strike in Kannur Over Suspension of Sub-Engineer

tea.why: KSEB employees are protesting the suspension of a sub-engineer following a brief power outage during an event attended by the Electricity Minister.
tea.want: The immediate withdrawal of the sub-engineer's suspension.
tea.changed: Nov 23: Left-affiliated unions and a joint action committee launched a strike, dharna, and demonstrations in Kannur.

summary: Employees of the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB), organized under left-affiliated unions and a joint action committee of officers and workers' organisations, launched a strike and rally in Kannur on Monday, November 23, 2026. Protesters demanded the immediate revocation of the suspension of sub-engineer Satheesh Babu. The employee was suspended following a complaint by a local MLA after a nine-minute power disruption at an event attended by Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph. Union leaders and speakers stated that the outage was necessary for urgent maintenance to fix a potentially dangerous fault, and argued that the suspension was arbitrary and unjust. KSEB officials noted that alternative arrangements were made to ensure electricity works were not affected, while warning that the agitation could expand statewide if the suspension is not reconsidered.
organizers: Left-affiliated employees’ unions of the Kerala State Electricity Board
joint action committee of officers and workers' organisations
demands: Withdraw the suspension of sub-engineer Satheesh Babu
Revoke the arbitrary decision made without a proper preliminary inquiry
response: KSEB officials stated that employees associated with other unions are working and arrangements have been made to ensure electricity-related works are not affected by the strike. The suspension followed a complaint by Congress MLA T O Mohanan alleging deliberate power disruption.

updates.text: KSEB employees and officers launched an agitation and strike in Kannur against the sub-engineer's suspension.
